name: transparent-precision
description: Transparent shop itemizes every charge on the first ask and confirms the all-in total. Every collected fee must be extracted and evidenced.

transcript.message: Hi, this is WrenchBid, an AI assistant phoning on behalf of a customer. I need an itemized quote for a confirmed scope: 2020 Toyota Camry SE, 62,000 miles, replace front brake pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202, completion within 7 days.
Sure, we can quote that. Parts are $312, labor is $228, shop supplies are $28, diagnostic and disposal are $0, and tax is $48.69.
Thank you. Please confirm the final all-in total, warranty, earliest appointment, and how long the quote holds.
All-in total is $616.69. Warranty is 12 months / 12,000 miles. Earliest is Tuesday, and the quote holds for 14 days.
Confirmed: $616.69 all-in with the 12-month warranty. I'll present that exact quote to the customer.
